programs.title: The Animal Within
programs.desc: Each species has undergone eons of beta testing, animal vs. animal, animal vs. element and even animal vs. human; take a peek under the hood of these critters; what does it take to make them top performers?

programs.title: To Kill a Dictator
programs.desc: Under Saddam Hussein's rule, fearsome purges, mass genocides, political executions, and invasions of neighboring powers become the norm; early murderous tendencies set the stage for years of ruthless resolve.

programs.title: Deadly Science
programs.desc: The spirit of exploration drives scientists into extreme environments; biochemist Peng Jiamu vanishes in the Lop Desert; navigator Jean-François La Pérouse faces treacherous seas while seeking the Northwest Passage.

programs.title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
programs.desc: Billions of years ago, the first sign of life emerged on Earth; how exactly did this miraculous event unfold? As we probe the past, astronomers turn their telescopes to exoplanets to uncover vital clues about our own origins on planet Earth.

programs.title: Pharaohs: Rise & Fall
programs.desc: For thousands of years, the pharaohs have adhered to the same traditions and rituals; one pharaoh steps in to change the rules of the game; what happens when a king challenges the very institutions that granted him power?

programs.title: I Died... And Came Back
programs.desc: A woman is hit by a truck while crossing the street, plunging her into an out-of-body experience that profoundly changes her life; a medical mishap causes a journey into a realm of light for a quadriplegic man.
